entries.label: Bubbles
entries.description: Scattered fine bubble-flecks across all ten fingernails, like a delicate speckled polish.

entries.label: Dried Blood
entries.description: A small crescent stain at the base of each fingernail, as if dried blood has crusted around every cuticle.

entries.label: Frost
entries.description: Delicate feathery frost wisps painted on each of the ten fingernails, like ice slowly forming across the polish.

entries.label: Full Polish (Dark)
entries.description: Solid full-coverage polish across every fingernail in a deep dark tone.

entries.label: Full Polish (Light)
entries.description: Solid full-coverage polish across every fingernail in a pale light tone.

entries.label: Full Polish (Medium)
entries.description: Solid full-coverage polish across every fingernail in an even mid-tone shade.

entries.label: Gradient
entries.description: A gradient on every fingernail, lighter at the cuticle and deepening toward the tip.

entries.label: Gradient (Inverted)
entries.description: An inverted gradient on every fingernail, deepest at the cuticle and fading out toward the tip.

entries.label: Lightning
entries.description: A small jagged lightning bolt etched onto each fingernail.

entries.label: Marble
entries.description: An irregular marble-vein pattern of fine ink lines and flecks across each fingernail.

entries.label: Marble (Reduced)
entries.description: A subtler marble-vein pattern on each fingernail, with sparser ink lines than the full marble polish.

entries.label: Semi-Polish (Medium)

tags.subject: central vertical stripe
tags.placement: down the middle of each fingernail

entries.description: A narrow vertical band of polish painted straight down the middle of each fingernail.

entries.label: Semi-Polish (Slanted)
entries.description: A diagonal half-coverage polish on each fingernail, slanted across from one side to the other.

entries.label: Splatters
entries.description: Tiny ink splatters speckled across all ten fingernails like flicked droplets of polish.

entries.label: No Tip

tags.subject: polish with bare tip
tags.placement: fingernail base leaving the tip bare

entries.description: Solid polish covering each fingernail but stopping short, leaving a bare crescent at the very tip.

entries.label: Tip L

tags.subject: narrow edge stripe
tags.placement: along one edge of each fingernail

entries.description: A thin vertical accent line of polish running down one edge of every fingernail.
